title: Demo Password Reset Guide

sections.title: Starting a reset
sections.text: Open the demo sign-in page and select Forgot password.

sections.title: Completing a reset
sections.text: Use the reset link sent to your demo email address to choose a new password.

sections.title: Expired reset links
sections.text: If your reset link has expired, request a new link from the demo sign-in page.
